name: FluxProof
description: Evidence-bearing public webpage change monitoring for people and agents. Returns source URL, observation time, prior/current SHA-256 hashes and bounded added/removed excerpts when normalized text changes.

skills.name: Free source preflight
skills.description: Checks whether a public page can be read and monitored. Creates no monitor, detects no change and never charges.

skills.name: Current offer
skills.description: Returns the current free and paid offers and their limits. Never charges.

skills.name: Create a monitor
skills.description: Starts watching one public HTML, text, JSON or XML page up to 3 MB with optional watched terms. Requires the buyer's API key. The first observation is a baseline, not a change.

skills.name: Manual check
skills.description: Runs one manual check of an existing monitor. Requires the buyer's API key.

skills.name: List observed changes
skills.description: Returns observed changes with prior/current hashes and bounded excerpts. Requires the buyer's API key.

limits: Public pages only. No sign-in, CAPTCHA solving, JavaScript rendering, or native email/SMS alerts. A content hash binds observed text; it does not certify that the source is true.
